name: BillTally
tagline: Plain-English Bill & Invoice Math Checker, Bank Statement Matcher & Spreadsheet Exporter
description: Helps bookkeepers, accountants, and small business owners turn messy bills, receipts, and bank statements into clean spreadsheets. Automatically checks every line item (Quantity x Unit Price) and tax total to the penny, matches bills against bank withdrawals to spot duplicate charges, and exports ready-to-use multi-tab .xlsx workbooks with live =SUM() formulas or accounting CSV files.
sample_prompts: Check this supplier bill to make sure every line item and sales tax adds up to the penny.
Compare our October supplier bills against our business checking statement and flag any duplicate charges.
Export these checked bills into a 3-tab Excel workbook with live =SUM() formulas.

privacy_and_data_handling.retention_policy: Bills and statements are checked in memory and never used to train models.
